15K likes, 343 comments - stephaniesanzo on October 29, 2026: "Here’s an Upper Body Workout to target your SHOULDERS & BACK 🔥💪

Training opposing muscle groups like this is a great way to enhance your muscle symmetry ⚖️

SAVE this post and try it for yourself 💯🙌

1A. Barbell Bradford Press 3x10
1B. Barbell Bent Over Row 3x20
2. Seated Chest Supported Row 3x10
3. Single Arm lateral Raise 3x12
4. Single Arm Lat Pulldown 3x15

Download my app @liftit.app if you’re looking for more workouts like this 📲

#gymroutine #shouldersworkout #trainwithme".
